checks.message: Redshift cluster not encrypted at rest
checks.context: Encryption must be set at creation time - enabling it later requires a cluster restore. An unencrypted Redshift cluster storing PII or financial data is a compliance failure.

checks.message: Public accessibility not disabled - verify your subnet configuration
checks.context: In a default VPC, Redshift clusters default to publicly accessible. In a custom VPC they default to private. Always explicitly set --no-publicly-accessible to ensure the cluster is not reachable from the internet regardless of VPC type.

checks.message: Redshift cluster set to publicly accessible
checks.context: A public Redshift cluster is reachable on port 5439 from the internet. Automated scanners find these within hours. Redshift should only be accessible from within your VPC.
Without it, COPY and UNLOAD traffic to S3 goes over the public internet. Enable enhanced VPC routing to force all traffic through your VPC so security groups and flow logs apply.

checks.message: Audit logging must be enabled separately via 'redshift enable-logging'
checks.context: Audit logging is not a create-cluster flag - it's a separate API call. Without it you have no record of who connected, what queries ran, or what data was accessed. Required for PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.

checks.message: Automated snapshot retention period not configured
checks.context: The default retention period is 1 day. For a data warehouse, 1-day retention is insufficient to detect data corruption or ransomware that isn't immediately noticed. Set to at least 7 days for production clusters.

checks.message: No final snapshot specified: Redshift cluster will be deleted without a backup
checks.context: Without --final-cluster-snapshot-identifier, all data in the cluster is permanently destroyed. Snapshots are cheap relative to the cost of losing a data warehouse.

checks.message: Explicitly skipping final snapshot. All warehouse data will be permanently lost
checks.context: With --skip-final-cluster-snapshot, no backup is taken before deletion. All Redshift data is gone forever.
If this is for a one-off data load, use a bastion host or VPN instead and revert immediately after. Never leave a data warehouse exposed to the internet.

checks.message: Verify the snapshot is not shared publicly after creation
checks.context: Redshift snapshots shared with 'all' expose your entire data warehouse to any AWS account. Check snapshot access after creation.

checks.message: Verify the destination region and KMS key for cross-region snapshot copies
checks.context: Snapshot copies to another region use the specified KMS key. If no key is specified, the default key in the destination region is used. Verify the destination region meets your data residency requirements.

checks.message: Classic resize causes cluster downtime - consider elastic resize for minimal disruption
checks.context: Classic resize makes the cluster read-only and may take hours. Elastic resize completes in minutes with brief unavailability. Verify the resize type and schedule during a maintenance window.
